description: City Solar Production is a dataset listed in City of Mesa open data portal (citydata.mesaaz.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Mesa. Information about solar energy generated on City owned assets and either captured or used by City Buildings. Dataset includes how much energy is generated monthly and the performance of non-City owned solar energy systems. Data is reported monthly by billing entity (SRP or PPA). Coverage: Mesa, Arizona. The portal files it under the category Environmental and Sustainability. The table has 18 columns. Attribution on the portal: Environmental Management and Sustainability. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is see the terms of use on the portal (no named licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-citydata-mesaaz-gov-portal.
